description: Use this when the coach has approved the principles their agent wrote from their own reels, posts and words: the ideas their AI coach teaches from. Send each principle with a short name, optional cue and why, and source links. It replaces the coach's principles. Set confirmation to true only after the coach approved exactly these; never invent a principle the coach did not teach.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

confirmation.description: True only after the coach approved exactly these principles.

sources.description: Links to the coach's own reels or posts this came from.

name: set_my_coach_principles
title: Set my coach's principles
